description: Add an editor note to a block of a post (WordPress 6.9 or later), as shown in the editor's Notes panel. Locate the block with anchor_text (a short exact snippet of its text) or block_index, or reply to an existing note with parent_id.

anchor_text.description: A short exact snippet of text from the block the note is about. The first block containing it is used.

block_index.description: Alternative to anchor_text: 0-based position among the top-level blocks.

parent_id.description: Reply to this note instead of starting a new thread.

post_id.description: The post to annotate. Not needed for a reply.

name: wp_create_note
title: Add editor note
